subject: Geopolitics
title: The Petrodollar System
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Petrodollar System.

hook.text: In 1974, Saudi Arabia agreed to price all oil in US dollars. In return, the US guaranteed Saudi security.

buildup.text: The petrodollar system forces every oil-buying nation to hold dollars. This creates global demand for the US currency.

discovery.text: Dollar demand lets the US run deficits other nations can't. It borrows cheaply because the world needs its currency.

twist.text: Saudi Arabia now sells some oil in yuan. The petrodollar's monopoly is cracking after 50 years of dominance.

climax.text: The petrodollar tied oil to American power. As alternatives grow, that link weakens but hasn't broken yet.

punchline.text: Price oil in dollars and the world funds your power.

quiz.question: What does the petrodollar system guarantee for the US?
options: Exclusive access to Middle Eastern oil reserves
Constant global demand for the US dollar
Military control over all oil shipping routes
